GASTRODUODENAL SURGERY

Prophylaxis is indicated in procedures involving entry into lumen of

gastrointestinal tract.

For procedures without entry into gastrointestinal tract, prophylaxis

is indicated only in patients with unusual risk for infection.

>>Patients with high gastric pH or acid-suppression therapy,

>>Patients with decreased gastroduodenal motility due to obstruction,

hemorrhage, gastric ulcer, malignancy, or diabetic gastroparesis, or

>>Obese patients
